paras: Turkey's Justice Minister confirmed on Saturday that HEX and PulseChain founder <g>Richard Heart</g> was arrested in Istanbul.
Police and Turkish intelligence detained him and his wife on Oct 14 in the Beşiktaş district. <u>Searches of 15 addresses followed.</u>
Police also seized rifles, unlicensed pistols and 1,400 rounds of ammunition.
slides.source: Turkish Justice Ministry via The Block, Decrypt

paras: Interpol issued a <g>Red Notice</g> in December 2024 at Finland's request, over suspected <r>aggravated tax fraud</r> and assault.
In the US, the SEC sued him in 2023 over <g>$1B+</g> in unregistered crypto offerings. <u>A judge dismissed that case in February 2025.</u>
It's not yet clear whether Finland has asked Turkey to extradite him.

items.l: raised in offerings the SEC sued over
